radio_filter.description: Narrows received audio to a handheld-radio voice profile.

roger_beep_enabled.description: Play a short local confirmation tone when someone releases PTT.

roger_beep_style.description: Which roger beep tone to play: classic_up, classic_down, single, or double.

channel_voice_enabled.description: Announce the zone and channel name aloud when the member manually changes channels.

channel_voice_name.description: Preferred browser speech synthesis voice name for channel announcements. Blank uses the browser/system default.

radio_layout_id.description: Member's selected radio layout ID. Blank uses the site default layout.

mic_device_id.description: Preferred microphone input device (MediaDeviceInfo.deviceId). Blank uses the browser/OS default device.

speaker_device_id.description: Preferred speaker/headphone output device (MediaDeviceInfo.deviceId), applied via HTMLMediaElement.setSinkId where the browser supports it. Blank uses the browser/OS default device.
